The [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] had an [[asteroid base]] in the [[Kauron asteroid field]]. It was equipped with a special zero [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] chamber designed to capture and hold [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==History==
[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] tracked the Cavrilhu Pirates back to their base in the asteroid field. Luke successfully [[Mission to the Kauron asteroid field|infiltrated]] their base, but was caught and nearly trapped by the inventive outlaws. However, he escaped and was rescued by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] shortly before their base self-destructed.
